findings.title: Duplicated fetch-wrapper logic between client.ts and client-admin.ts
findings.note: Both modules build the same BASE/token/headers structure and fetch+json+catch flow, differing only in constant values (URL, env var name) and one has a timeout/log call the other lacks. Change-history coupling (ratio 0.889) confirms they are edited together.

looks_bad_but_fine.why: legacyFormat delegates to formatMoney rather than reimplementing it; not duplication despite similar name/shape.
